ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
notes: annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2009-12-31 is filed as 1.09 (10-K filed 2011-02-28) and as 0.545 (10-K filed 2012-02-24) — restated for a share-basis change with no ratio fact filed — the diluted share count for the period ended 2010-06-30 was re-filed ×2.00 on 2011-08-02; read as 2-for-1 (the per-share values move ×2.0000, the share count ×2.0000); 0.545 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared)

annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2010-12-31 is filed as 1.15 (10-K filed 2011-02-28) and as 0.575 (10-K filed 2012-02-24, 10-K filed 2013-02-22) — restated for a share-basis change with no ratio fact filed — the diluted share count for the period ended 2010-06-30 was re-filed ×2.00 on 2011-08-02; read as 2-for-1 (the per-share values move ×2.0000, the share count ×2.0000); 0.575 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared)

share-basis change with no ratio fact filed: the FY DPS for the period ended 2009-12-31 and the diluted share count for the period ended 2010-06-30 were both re-filed by the same factor (first on 2011-08-02) — read as a 2-for-1 split effective 2011-08-02; every per-share fact last filed before 2011-08-02 is restated by it

split adjustment (declared DPS): 4 facts for periods ending 2008-12-31..2010-03-31 were last filed before the 2-for-1 split effective 2011-08-02 (no ratio fact: the factor the filer re-filed its FY DPS and diluted share counts by) and are divided by the split ratio (filed, or evidenced by the re-filed values) to today's share basis

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 3.04 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.79, 2026-06-30: 0.79) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.75, 2025-06-30: 0.75)
